assumptions.capacity_and_engine_reserve: Hypothetical CUDA totals and overhead, explicitly not GPU measurements.
assumptions.GPU_buffers: All decoder linear modules, partial TP sharding; empty global V slots also allocated; max rank shared by all slots.
assumptions.package_sizes: BF16 independent PEFT matrices, no embeddings, modules_to_save or training optimizer states; safetensors header/config add bytes.
assumptions.tensor_estimate_exclusions: Runtime repacking, extra graph/prefill/Punica workspaces, media buffers, fragmentation and memory held outside the profiled executor.
assumptions.scenarios: Working-use envelopes; vLLM normally reserves the residual KV pool, so nvidia-smi can be near 90% even with one request.
assumptions.upper_bound_warning: Cache capacity and file-size ceilings do not prove concurrency, throughput or quality.
